comment: kiln.stations.client (kiln-items.dll, since 0.2.0-dev.31.13): the client world's ClientFactoryInfo, the station cache the game's own station HUD and station screen read (Easy HUD's 'client workshop cache'). Read-only. FactoryInfoInit (client 26430625 0x3bf5d0) builds the 0x30f00-byte resource: rows at +0 (inline, 1000 x 0xc8), row count +0x08, capacity +0x10, the base groups at +0x30d68/+0x30d70 (16 x 20 bytes: base GUID, u16 first row, u16 rows). FactoryInfoGroups (0xe869b0) is the stock getter of one base's rows, FactoryInfoFind (0x3bf700) player_ui's binary search of a row by entity (rows sorted by the u32 entity at +0). FactoryInfoRead (0x3c0920) is the network decoder's per-row read: every field offset of a row is captured from it, and its stream order matches the server's encoder (0x4a468c) field for field (docs/re/stations.md section 13). FactoryRemaining (0xb2d6e0) is the HUD's remaining-time helper (one craft = float(ns * 1e-9) * FactorySpeed -> ns; craft * (crafts + 1) - (now - start)); the two HUD call sites tie it to stations/FactorySpeed on the BalancingRegistry copy at G38UiPlayData+0x4667d8 and the clock at G38UiPlayData+0. No hook, no write.
